evidence.quote: The full sample consists of 143,462 firm-quarter observations from 1988 to 1999 with sufficient Compustat, CRSP, and IBES data for our tests.
evidence.description: Full-sample parent population and original date range.

evidence.quote: The number of observations in any particular test will vary depending on the number of future quarters of cash flows or stock returns required for the test and the availability of Compustat or CRSP data necessary for the particular test.
evidence.description: Fit-level counts vary with horizon and required future data; no exact horizon-specific N is supplied.

evidence.quote: For this reason we sum over three future periods: one, two or three years after the initial quarter in which the pro forma earnings number is announced.
evidence.description: Cash-flow outcome horizons.

evidence.quote: where future cash flow is measured as either CFO or FCF, summed over one, two or three years starting with quarter t þ 1.
evidence.description: Future cash-flow windows begin with the quarter after the current observation.

evidence.quote: All variables are calculated as per share amounts, which are then scaled by total assets per share at the end of the initial fiscal quarter (data item #9/data item #15).
evidence.description: Equation (1) scaling rule and cited item numbers.

evidence.quote: Total assets are defined as Total assets (#44) divided by shares outstanding (#15).
evidence.description: Table 1's total-assets-per-share definition conflicts with the equation's #9/#15 citation.

evidence.quote: we obtain the unadjusted IBES database.
evidence.description: Authors use unadjusted IBES to avoid split adjustment of historical EPS.

evidence.quote: Pro Forma Earnings is the IBES reported actual earnings per share.
evidence.description: Pro Forma Earnings definition.

evidence.quote: GAAP earnings is defined as earnings per share before extraordinary items and discontinued operations, using either basic (data item #19) or diluted (data item #9), depending on the IBES basic/diluted flag.
evidence.description: GAAP EPS basis is selected to match the IBES basic/diluted flag.

evidence.quote: Operating income per share is defined in Compustat (data item #177)
evidence.description: Special Items are constructed from Compustat operating income per share less GAAP earnings per share.

evidence.quote: We define Growth as the change in sales from the same quarter in the previous year (data item #2).
evidence.description: Sales Growth uses same-quarter prior-year sales.

evidence.quote: We also control for Accruals, defined as GAAP earnings less cash from operations.
evidence.description: Accruals definition.

evidence.quote: we adjust it to a diluted basis, if necessary, by using the most recent annual dilution factor, computed from basic shares outstanding (data item #54) and diluted shares outstanding (data item #171).
evidence.description: Annual dilution-factor adjustment for quarterly operating income per share.

evidence.quote: CFO_SUM1, 2, and 3 are cash from operations (#108) scaled by the applicable weighted average shares outstanding (#15), summed for one, two or three years starting with quarter t þ 1.
evidence.description: CFO outcome includes a per-quarter weighted-share denominator within the future horizon.

evidence.quote: FCF_SUM1, 2, and 3 are calculated as cash from operations (#108) - capital expenditures (#90), scaled by the applicable weighted average shares outstanding (#15), summed for one, two or three years starting with quarter t þ 1.
evidence.description: FCF outcome uses CFO less capex, with per-quarter weighted-share scaling.

evidence.quote: To limit the influence of outliers, all variables are winsorized at the 1% and 99% levels.
evidence.description: Winsorization rule.

evidence.quote: we estimate equation (1) separately for each quarter and report the mean of the resulting coefficient estimates.
evidence.description: Quarterly regressions and mean coefficients.

evidence.quote: We then compute a t-statistic based on the quarterly estimates (i.e., a Fama-MacBeth t-statistic), multiplying the traditional standard error by the Newey-West adjustment in order to account for the possible serial correlation in the quarterly estimates.
evidence.description: Fama–MacBeth inference with Newey–West correction.

evidence.quote: n equal to the number of overlapping periods in each test
evidence.description: Note 9 sets the Newey–West lag count to overlapping periods, with n=3, 7 and 11 for one-, two- and three-year tests.
Exact COMP.FUNDQ probe confirms all 648 columns, including the cited current quarter fields and GVKEY/date keys; bounded sample does not establish historical coverage.
Exact COMP.FUNDA probe confirms all 949 columns, including candidate annual basic/diluted share fields and GVKEY/date keys; bounded sample does not establish annual coverage.
Exact historical IBES–CRSP link probe confirms TICKER, PERMNO, sdate, edate and SCORE fields; no population coverage is established.
